description: Source code for activity management in a project collaboration platform, including functions to record, retrieve, and broadcast activity events related to projects and tasks.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Data model representing an activity event.

classes.name: ActivityScope
classes.description: Enumeration indicating the scope of an activity (project or task).

classes.name: ProjectMember
classes.description: Data model representing a member of a project.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Data model representing a task within a project.

methods.name: Project _ensure_project_member(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Verifies if a user is a member of a specific project; raises HTTPException if not.

methods.name: Activity record_activity( db: AsyncSession, *, project_id: int, actor_id: int, type: str, message: str, task_id: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Records a new activity event for a project or task, broadcasts it via websockets, and saves it to the database.

methods.name: List[Activity] get_project_activity(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int, limit: int = 50)
methods.description: Fetches recent activity logs for a given project, ensuring user authorization.

methods.name: List[Activity] get_task_activity(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int, limit: int = 50)
methods.description: Fetches recent activity logs for a specific task within a project, ensuring user authorization and task ownership.
